# Review Retriever and Review Intelligence

> Review Retriever retrieves public written reviews from Apple App Store and Google Play listings. Review Intelligence analyzes those reviews while keeping evidence, inference, and business outcomes separate.

This file is an optional content map for systems that choose to read llms.txt. It is not a crawler permission policy. Crawler access is controlled by https://reviews.doubledash.me/robots.txt.

## Use the product

- [Review Retriever](https://reviews.doubledash.me/): Retrieve up to 500 public written reviews as a Markdown packet.
- [Review Intelligence](https://www.doubledash.me/tools/review-intelligence/): Understand the analysis method, decisions it supports, and its limits.
- [MCP setup](https://www.doubledash.me/tools/review-intelligence/mcp/): Connect the read-only Review Retriever MCP server to Claude Cowork, Codex, or another remote HTTP MCP client.
- [Worked analysis example](https://www.doubledash.me/tools/review-intelligence/#example): See how a review theme is named, prioritized, and traced to evidence.

## What the connected workflow can do

- Retrieve another app, country, Apple storefront, or Google Play language.
- Continue through additional Google Play batches using a continuation cursor.
- Analyze an app's or competitor's public reviews for repeated complaints, moments of value, expectation gaps, customer language, and positioning openings.
- Trace findings back to exact review evidence instead of presenting a generic sentiment score.

## Boundaries

- The web export returns up to 500 public written reviews.
- The MCP returns up to 500 reviews per response and can continue through Google Play pages until the public source returns no further page.
- Apple coverage remains limited by the public feed available for each storefront.
- Review evidence can show patterns in the retrieved sample. It cannot by itself prove revenue, retention, causality, or the views of every user.
- Review Retriever uses public store listings, requires no store-console login, and does not modify store data.
